xgboost: saved stage head; no retraining, threshold selection or confidence rejection
visual_images: four frozen raw views plus three frozen 31/61/91-day auxiliary views
visual_input_exclusions: author notes, block statistics, numeric predictions, old stage outputs, hidden mechanisms
stage_support: all stages need observed frozen activity and finite 61-day velocity; A/D also need finite 61-day tangential acceleration
stage_endpoints: half-open sparse spans; omitted dates unknown; reject outside activity without clipping
